newsitem.title: GERMANY: Waigel says markka ERM link important for Finland.
newsitem.headline: Waigel says markka ERM link important for Finland.

text.p: German Finance Minister Theo Waigel said Finland's decision to join the EU's exchange rate mechanism was an important step for Finland en route to its participation in European economic and monetary union.

In a statement released in Bonn, Waigel said Finland's decision was a clear signal that it will continue its policies of monetary stability. "I welcome the entry of the Finnish markka as an important step for Finland en route to the European monetary union," Waigel said.
Waigel said the move would strengthen the credibility in international financial markets of Finland's convergence policies.

His statement was released shortly after a meeting in Brussels of senior finance ministry and central bank officials from the 15 EU member states decided, at Finland's request, to link the markka with the ERM.
